kjv: after that he (God) gave [unto them] judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years
mine: for about 450 years. And after that he (God) gave them judges
note: In the early text (P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, C) the 450 years cover the sojourn, wilderness and conquest; the TR applies them to the judges, which conflicts with 1 Kgs 6:1 (480 years from exodus to temple).

kjv: when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought
mine: As they (Paul and Barnabas) went out, the people begged
note: TR adds "the Jews" and "the Gentiles", introducing an ethnic contrast that Luke reserves for 13:45–46.
